title: Kagamine Len — Sentimental Melody〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Welcome! What can I get you today?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Today, we'll both have lemon soda!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: MEIKO, are Akito and the others coming today?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Well, they haven't shown up yet.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They're preparing for an event that's coming up, so they may be too busy with practice to drop by.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
It's some kind of battle or competition.
Kohane's dad might go and see them...
Oh, Toya's dad too...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wow, really? Then they must be training extra hard to make sure they do their absolute best!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Let me pick some nice glasses for your drinks...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hey, Rin...
That one cup's missing from that shelf...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Um... I noticed that...
It looks like there's a cup missing from that shelf...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, I know which one you mean.
It was cracked, so I had to remove it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes, I noticed when I was tidying up earlier.
It's such a pity, since MEIKO really liked it.
She seemed pretty sad.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Was it was my fault that cup got cracked...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I should've found you a step stool instead of asking you to stand on your toes to reach that shelf.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: No, it's my fault. I should've said that wouldn't be safe, but I was too careless.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I'll go and apologize to MEIKO.
You wait here...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No, wait! I want to apologize with you!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
But you've done nothing wrong!
It was because of me...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
No, it wasn't!
It's like I set you up for that...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, no...! It's about that cup!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
We're the ones that probably cracked it and...
We're so sorry!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hold on, you two...
Why are you saying you did it?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It happened when we were helping you out the other day, you know?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We were putting the tableware away, and I bumped a cup into that one while we were putting them back on that shelf...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And I told him to stand on his toes to reach for it so...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ah, that's why you asked about the missing cup...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Well, I have news for you.
You two didn't do anything wrong.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You were putting cups away on the shelf above the one that had the crack in it.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Take a look... Was it this?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
So that means...
We had nothing to do with that cup?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes.
It wasn't your fault at all.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But I still feel bad that you lost one of your favorite cups, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Well, it'll be hard to use it as a cup but...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? Then what do you plan on doing with it?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. I don't know exactly what yet,
but Miku said she has an idea for it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's the plan, so stay tuned!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Len, what do you think she's gonna do with it?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Beats me, but I'm curious to find out!
